channels.name: Cosmic Kids Yoga
channels.why: Jaime turns breathing, stretching and calm-down into interactive story adventures so kids feel their feelings settle while they move.
channels.note: Storytelling yoga plus 'Zen Den' and 'Peace Out' mindfulness/relaxation series; long-form, calm, advertiser-safe. Core channel of this niche.

channels.name: New Horizon - Meditation & Sleep Stories
channels.why: Gentle guided sleep stories and meditations that let kids drift into imagined worlds while learning to relax their bodies and minds.
channels.note: Long-form bedtime meditations/sleep stories; very calm and warm. Best for wind-down; not active-learning.

channels.name: GoZen!
channels.why: Animated stories make anxiety, worry and big feelings visible so kids get curious about the science of their own emotions and simple coping skills.
channels.note: Animated SEL/anxiety-relief shorts and lessons; some content aimed at parents/teachers. Lesser-known gem.

channels.name: Big Life Journal
channels.why: Warm animated 'Buddies' episodes spark growth-mindset thinking, helping kids reframe mistakes and keep trying.
channels.note: Growth-mindset/SEL animated series plus parent resources; niche gem. Channel URL uses /c/BigLifeJournal.

channels.name: Slumberkins
channels.why: Cuddly creature characters read gentle storybooks that name feelings and model kindness, self-esteem and calm.
channels.note: SEL storytime with plush characters (from family therapist + educator); best for ages 3-6. Lesser-known gem.

channels.name: Everyday Speech
channels.why: Short video-modeling scenarios show real kids navigating friendship, sharing feelings and self-regulation, sparking 'what would I do?' reflection.
channels.note: Evidence-based social-skills / video-modeling clips; instructional/classroom tone. Niche SEL gem.

channels.name: ClassDojo (Big Ideas / Mojo)
channels.why: Mojo the monster learns about growth mindset, empathy, gratitude and mindfulness in short animated stories that make brain-and-feelings science fun.
channels.note: 'Big Ideas' SEL animated series is the draw; channel also hosts teacher tutorials. Warm and kid-friendly.

channels.name: Mind Yeti
channels.why: Guided 'hums' with soothing soundscapes teach kids to focus attention, calm down and connect with kindness and gratitude.
channels.note: Research-based guided mindfulness audio from nonprofit Committee for Children; ages 5-12. Calm, lesser-known.

channels.name: Yogapalooza with Bari Koral
channels.why: Catchy yoga songs like 'Fly Like a Butterfly' get little kids breathing, moving and self-soothing through music and mindfulness.
channels.note: Kids-yoga music and mindful movement pioneer; best for ages 3-7. Niche gem; channel also at /user/barikoral.

channels.name: Moshi Kids
channels.why: Dreamy bedtime stories and guided SEL meditations help kids wind down, name feelings and fall asleep calm.
channels.note: Sleep/mindfulness bedtime stories and mindful exercises; wind-down content, not active learning. Handle best-guess.

channels.name: Smiling Mind
channels.why: Animated mindfulness intros and short practices (like 'Bubble Bounce' mindful looking) teach kids simple attention and calming skills.
channels.note: Australian mental-health nonprofit; mix of kids and some adult meditation content. Handle unconfirmed; also /user/SmilingMindTV.

channels.name: Sesame Street
channels.why: Elmo and friends sing and story their way through emotions, kindness and empathy, giving little kids warm language for big feelings.
channels.note: Large channel, but feelings/kindness SEL is genuinely central to its mission; use emotions/kindness playlists. Best for ages 3-6.
